subject: Kobo onboarding: provisional PO overshoot in staging & line-item reconciliation
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Kobo Inc <procurement@kobo.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kobo onboarding: provisional PO overshoot in staging & line-item reconciliation

Hi Jane / Kobo team,

Quick heads-up from onboarding: when we pushed your vendor profile into staging last night the system auto-generated provisional PO 15782 and routed a few line items to the default ledger. That provisional PO picked up a cumulative spend that exceeds the spend cap you specified on the vendor intake form.

What we need to sort quickly so we can issue a formal PO number:
- Confirm whether the three line items on the intake should map to the existing SKU groups (they currently show as misc.SW, misc.SV, misc.SL in our ledger).
- If any of these are one-off professional services vs. recurring subscription, flag them — they need different spend buckets.
- Please return the completed onboarding form (I attached v1) AND the vendor W-9 if available.

Action requested: can you reply by COB PDT today with the line-item mapping or corrected invoice? If you prefer, we can schedule a 20-minute call to walk the mapping with Monica (procurement) and get the provisional PO re-staged.

Attaching: kobo_onboarding_form.pdf (fill + sign) — I included the provisional PO stub below for your reference.

--- provisional_po_15782.txt (auto-generated) ---
PO: 15782 (PROVISIONAL)
Date: 2027-05-04
Total (staged): USD 72,450.00
Spend cap declared on intake: USD 50,000.00
Line items:
  1) misc.SW — USD 45,000.00
  2) misc.SV — USD 20,500.00
  3) misc.SL — USD 7,950.00

Thanks — want to avoid issuing a formal PO that violates your cap. Monica, looping you for procurement triage. Rishi, FYI on the potential pricing exception if Kobo pushes through the larger spend.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Procurement Partner, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Jane Doe <jane.doe@kobo.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kobo onboarding: provisional PO overshoot in staging & line-item reconciliation

Hi Kimberly — thanks for catching this. We ran into two issues on our side that explain the mismatch:
1) Our intake had the monthly subscription listed in CAD (we missed marking currency), so the system converted at the USD rate and inflated the staged amount. That subscription should be USD 30,000 annual, not USD 45,000.
2) The professional services line (integration/setup) should be split into two deliverables: 50% milestone (USD 4,500) and 50% post-launch support (USD 3,450) — those were combined in the invoice you received.

I've attached a corrected invoice (kobo_corrected_invoice.xlsx) and a filled onboarding form. The corrected totals bring provisional PO to USD 38,950 which is under the USD 50,000 cap.

We also noted the provisional PO comment — we agree we need an official PO number but want to avoid the cap exception. Please confirm receipt and next steps.

Thanks,
Jane Doe
Head of Procurement, Kobo Inc.
procurement@kobo.com
Attachment: kobo_corrected_invoice.xlsx (Excel workbook, 2 sheets)
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@kobo.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 5 May 2027 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kobo onboarding: provisional PO overshoot in staging & line-item reconciliation

Hi Jane — thanks for the quick turnaround and the corrected invoice. I pulled the workbook into procurement and did a line-by-line mapping. Two quick clarifications before I can request a formal PO number from Finance:
- Confirm accounting codes: is misc.SW the subscription (annual) and misc.SV the setup services? The corrected invoice has descriptions but not our internal mapping codes.
- Please add a line that explicitly marks "one-time professional services" vs "recurring subscription" so Finance can place spend into the right budget buckets.

If you can add those two small edits to the invoice, I can push the formal PO request this afternoon. If not, I can create a provisional mapping and tag the PO with a note for later reconciliation, but that will require a 1-business-day delay.

Also uploading the onboarding form to our Drive and will flag for the vendor file once the PO is final.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Procurement Lead, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Jane Doe <jane.doe@kobo.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 7 May 2027 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kobo onboarding: provisional PO overshoot in staging & line-item reconciliation

Jane / team — appreciate the fixes. I reviewed Monica's notes and authorized the following operational steps:
- Monica will accept the corrected invoice as the canonical mapping. Monica: please confirm you have set misc.SW = subscription (recurring) and misc.SV = integration/setup (one-time).
- Finance will issue a formal PO number once the updated invoice includes the explicit "one-time vs recurring" flags.
- To avoid blocking the onboarding flows, I've approved a one-time administrative exception to re-stage PO 15782 in "provisional-hold" so we don't accidentally allocate spend against it while we wait for the final invoice. That puts a soft hold on $38,950 of the provisional ledger.

Jane: please attach the small edit (one-line note in the invoice) and upload the signed onboarding_form.pdf. Once Monica confirms, I'll ping Finance to mint the PO.

For the record, attachments pushed to the thread: kobo_onboarding_form.pdf (signed), kobo_corrected_invoice.xlsx (final v2).

Thanks everyone — will track until PO is minted.

— Rishi
